title: Implement spec 19 device HMI: v0.1 screen inventory + LED language across tiers
description: spec/19-device-ux.md is now normative. Work items: (1) screen ring (Boot/Status/Position/Last-message/screensaver) on T-Echo e-ink per §5/§6 — data from existing CoAP resources; (2) same ring on Heltec OLED with screensaver; (3) LED language table §10 in the board LED drivers (fixed patterns, event-driven); (4) button grammar §4 (short-press ring advance, hold-to-SOS, guarded reset); (5) mono token set §7 in the display driver; (6) string table §13. All choices not covered by the spec go through §12 tiebreakers recorded as ux-default beads — do not escalate aesthetics. SOS semantics (§8) are the only blocking questions.
